fragments: The safety lockout, cleared by one key
The signal spiking as the field opened

true_memory.speaker: MEMORY
true_memory.text: Voss begged you to stop. You turned the override anyway. Not for the signal — for her.

true_memory.speaker: MNEME
true_memory.text: You are close to the truth now. It will not be kind.

false_memory.speaker: MEMORY
false_memory.text: The lockout failed on its own. No one was to blame.

false_memory.speaker: MNEME
false_memory.text: Comforting. False. Order the fragments again.
